site.headline: Ideas made visual.
site.intro: I’m Vlad Frolov, a designer working across social content, illustration, packaging and visual identity. I turn clear ideas into images with character.

about.title: Clear ideas, strong images.
paragraphs: I’m a Prague-based designer interested in the point where a good idea becomes something people want to stop and look at.

My work moves between image making, typography, packaging and digital formats. My background in editorial production and frontend development also helps me carry concepts cleanly from first sketch to finished asset.

contact.text: For roles, freelance work, collaborations, or a chat about a project, send me an email.

projects.title: Taktik
projects.summary: Cover and interior design for educational books and workbooks published by Taktik.
story: I design covers and interior layouts for Taktik educational titles across subjects and age groups. The work has to make dense learning material clear, approachable and easy to navigate, while giving each series a distinct visual character.

Cover systems balance subject cues, illustration, photography and strong colour. Inside, reusable grids, typographic hierarchies and exercise structures support teachers and students across long, content-heavy books.

projects.title: Wellwet
projects.summary: Social campaigns, event identities and image making for Prague party series Wellwet.
story: I create campaign systems for Wellwet that carry each event from announcement to line-up, artist reveals and real-world promotion. The work combines expressive typography, illustration, photography and changing colour palettes while keeping a recognizable energy across the series.

projects.title: Vilgain
projects.summary: Selected packaging and product visuals created for Vilgain across food and performance products.
story: This selection brings together packaging work for a wide product range, from prepared food and snacks to supplements. Each format needed to stay direct and legible while fitting into Vilgain’s broader visual system.
The work balances restrained packaging with energetic product imagery, using ingredients, movement and tightly controlled colour to give each product its own appetite and purpose.

projects.title: Kosmas
projects.summary: A self-initiated identity and campaign direction for Czech bookseller Kosmas.
story: The concept makes books feel physical, immediate and a little unruly. Condensed type, halftone imagery and a red-led palette give the brand a voice that can be literary without becoming precious.
The system stretches across e-commerce, motion, outdoor-style graphics and merchandise, keeping a recognizable tone while leaving room for changing books, authors and messages.

projects.title: Kopr
projects.summary: A self-initiated restaurant identity built around a direct wordmark and a flexible line motif.
story: Kopr is an identity study for a contemporary restaurant. The visual language pairs an assertive serif wordmark with a fine, wandering line inspired by stems, herbs and the long shape of dill.
A small palette of black, green, ochre and warm neutrals gives the system enough range for storefront graphics, posters and event communication while keeping the restaurant recognizable.

projects.title: Probio
projects.summary: A speculative packaging redesign for an organic flour range with a bold colour and illustration system.
story: This speculative redesign gives a broad flour range an easy wayfinding system. Crop illustrations identify ingredients while strong colour blocks make varieties quick to distinguish on shelf.
A simple rising-sun device ties the range together and adapts to smaller baking ingredients, creating one family from many different products.
